baseBranch.description: Deprecated: set base under settings: (every flow) or flows.<name>.settings, the branch a flow's work starts from and targets. It never chose the branch .chernabog/ is read from, which is GitHub's default. A flow's base wins over this.

settings.description: Settings every flow shares, such as the reviewer pool (reviewers), the CI limits (ciRounds, ciTimeout) and the local gate (localGate, install), read by the flows whose settings declare them. flows.<name>.settings overrides them key by key.

labels.description: The label names the SDK's blocks use, by what each means.

base.description: The branch the flow's work starts from and its pull requests target, such as develop in git flow. Unset: the repo's default branch.

humanOnly.description: Decisions the agent must stop for and leave to a person, beyond the repo's and the machine's.

humanOnlyPaths.description: Paths a change must not touch; one that does goes to a person instead of a pull request.

notes.description: Repo facts the agent should know.

reviewers.description: The reviewer pool, by GitHub login: a pull request with green CI asks one of them at random to review it, never its author. Each needs write access, since the reviewer merges on the automated path.

reviewRounds.description: Re-reviews of one pull request before a person takes over.

localGate.description: Commands the change must pass before its pull request opens.

localGateRounds.description: Agent attempts to get the local gate passing before a person takes over.

anyOf.description: Run in a fresh worktree before the agent starts. null for none.

ciRounds.description: Pushes to fix red CI before a person takes over.

ciGates.description: The checks that must pass: those the base branch requires (every check when it requires none, or GitHub won't say), or every check.

ciOptionalFailures.description: Whether a failing check that doesn't gate still makes CI red (hold), or is left alone (ignore).

anyOf.description: The GitHub project board an issue moves across as it is claimed. null for none.

planNodes.description: The most tasks one plan may hold, its verify node aside.

planRounds.description: Times the agent is asked to fix a plan that fails its checks before a person takes over.

stackDepth.description: The most layers one stack may hold before the run stops starting new ones and waits for the bottom to merge.

atOnce.description: How many of the epic's ready tasks the run implements at once. Default: 2.

ship.description: Whether the epic's layers are on the automated path: each pull request the run opens is labelled auto:ship, and the run merges each approved layer once the layers below it have merged.
